units.name: Design Methods
tips: Iterate through multiple sketches before committing to a final digital concept.
Always anchor your design decisions in user research, personas, and problem briefs.
Document your design journey thoroughly — process books are critical for high marks.

units.name: Design Thinking and Innovation
tips: Apply the Double Diamond framework: Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver.
Conduct empathy interviews to discover latent, unstated user needs.
Test low-fidelity prototypes early with real users to validate key assumptions.

units.name: Typography and Visual Communication
tips: Master the fundamentals of hierarchy, kerning, leading, and baseline grids.
Limit each project to two harmonious, complementary typefaces for clean readability.
Check color contrast ratios to ensure visual accessibility across all devices.

units.name: Branding and Identity Design
tips: Design flexible visual identity systems that scale from app icons to billboards.
Test logo marks in single-color monochrome before introducing brand colors.
Compile comprehensive brand guidelines outlining logo usage, colors, and tone.

units.name: UX/UI and Interaction Design
tips: Follow WCAG accessibility standards for font sizes, contrast, and touch targets.
Build interactive Figma prototypes to communicate user flows and micro-interactions.
Prioritise intuitive usability and user feedback over purely decorative visual flair.

units.name: Motion Design and Animation
tips: Study the 12 principles of animation to make transitions and easing feel organic.
Storyboard motion sequences on paper before jumping into After Effects.
Keep file assets neatly organised with clear naming conventions for smooth rendering.
